design_philosophy.vibe: Premium, privacy-first, trustworthy, clean, restrained. Inspired by Apple Find My, Things 3, Linear.

Timeline.description: The hero feature. A gorgeous vertical activity log with place names, durations, and transit indicators.
Timeline.structure: Vertical list grouped by Day. Left side: Timeline axis. Right side: Content cards.

visuals.place_node: 12px solid circle in Brand Accent (#007AFF) for active, #8E8E93 for past

Timeline.interactions: Smooth scroll, snap to day headers.

ScopeSlider.description: Tactile slider for granular per-friend privacy control.

visuals.thumb: 24px by 24px white circle with subtle shadow. Haptic feedback on step change.

Map.style: Muted grayscale or pale native style (no busy POIs).
Map.friend_chip: Floating pill above map. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur. Contains avatar and name.

BottomNavigation.description: Tab bar for Map, Friends, Timeline, Profile.

Buttons.primary: Black (#0A0A0A) background, White text, 16px radius, 56px height.

onboarding.description: Minimalist 3D map pin connection for the first splash screen.
Glowing shield over folded map for the privacy permissions screen.

avatars.description: Premium grainy gradient background for user initials/avatars.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (React Native) or `data-testid` (Web) attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a robust navigation structure (Tabs nested in a Stack for Auth/Onboarding).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement UI components with standard StyleSheet, matching the premium minimal aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Timeline is the key feature - ensure the vertical axis and connecting lines between locations and transit look perfect.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Slider must snap to the specified 6 values (10m, 1h, 6h, 12h, 24h, Off).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use the provided image URLs for the splash/onboarding and default avatar backgrounds.
